text: DSH Permission Guard 是一个适用于 DSH Web 客户端的权限设置页，通过 settings.section 接入设置面板，并由 Host API 读取权限预设与会话状态。用户可以调整之后新建会话的默认预设，也可以逐个会话切换现有会话的预设；页面支持查看当前默认值、搜索会话、刷新状态，并在启用完全权限前要求确认。适合需要集中管理新会话权限和已有会话权限的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

DSH Permission Guard adds a permission page to the DSH web settings panel. Users can change the default preset for future sessions or switch an existing session individually. The page lists and searches sessions and confirms before enabling full access. No API key or external service is needed.
想分别设置新开的 DSH 会话和已经打开的会话使用什么权限。
能不能在设置页面把某个现有会话单独加入完全权限白名单？
I want a settings page to change the permission preset used by future sessions.
DSH Permission Guard 的功能「新会话默认权限」：在设置页选择之后新建会话使用的权限预设。点击完全权限选项前会先显示确认步骤，恢复按钮可切回工作区写入预设。
DSH Permission Guard 的功能「单会话权限白名单」：列表展示已有会话及当前预设，可搜索会话并逐个切换预设；再次移出白名单时切回安全预设。

dsh-permission-guard README · Introduction：

dsh-permission-guard

A Permission Settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

One page under **Settings** that does two things:

dsh-permission-guard README · Introduction：- **New-session default** — one button makes every session created from then on start in
  **Full access**; a second button restores the safe *Workspace write* default.
- **Existing-session allowlist** — sessions that already exist keep their own permission.
  You can raise one of them to Full access, one session at a time.

The page asks for confirmation before enabling Full access, and names the risk in plain words.

dsh-permission-guard README · Install：**Plugin market** — once listed, install it from **Settings → Plugins** in the app.

**Today, from this repository** (the CLI adds the package to your profile and registers its
bundle in one step):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:frostnova04/dsh-permission-guard
```

Swap `desktop` for your own profile name if it differs. A pinned tarball works the same way:

dsh-permission-guard README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/frostnova04/dsh-permission-guard/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-permission-guard-0.1.0.tgz
```

Reload the window afterwards. The page appears under **Settings → Permissions** (权限设置).

dsh-permission-guard README · What it actually does：This plugin does not invent a permission system. It writes the permission presets DSH already has:

- the **new-session default** is the `defaultPreset` value of the `permission` settings
  namespace, which DSH reads when it creates a session. Changing it never touches a session
  that already exists.
- an **allowlist entry** performs the same preset write as the `/permission` command, so the
  change is recorded in that one session's own log and survives a restart.

dsh-permission-guard README · What it actually does：Full access means sandbox `danger-full-access` with approval policy `never`: no confirmation
prompts, and writes to any file the DSH process can reach.

dsh-permission-guard README · Why a page instead of a dropdown：DSH ships a single "permission" row in **Settings → General**. This plugin gives the same write
a dedicated page with the two operations people actually asked for: one switch for everything
new, and a per-session list for everything old.
section: Why a page instead of a dropdown

text:
dsh-permission-guard README · Requirements：- DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer (desktop app and `dsh web` both work).
- The standard `settings` and `permission-presets` plugins, which every standard composition
  includes.

dsh-permission-guard README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test
```

- `test/host.test.mjs` mounts the Host API on a real HTTP server with fake Cordis services and
  drives every route, including the connection gate.
- `test/client.test.mjs` loads `client.js` the way the browser module loader does, registers the
  settings section, renders the page with `react-test-renderer`, and clicks through the
  confirmation flow and one allowlist row.

dsh-permission-guard README · Layout：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: the `/permission-guard/api/*` routes, catalog and session reads, preset writes |
| `client.js` | Client half: the `settings.section` registration and the page |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The single Loader row that inserts the plugin |
| `locale/*.json` | The title and description plugin managers display |
| `icon.svg`, `assets/icon-180.png` | The plugin icon (a raster copy for storefronts) |
